QUESTIONS & PERSPECTIVES

A little clarity.
A fresh perspective.

Answers to the questions we hear most, and ideas to help you think about your next product.

Frequently asked questions

How do we start a project?

Send us a short outline of your idea, the people it serves, and the problem you want to solve. We will discuss the scope, technical approach, and a practical delivery plan with you.

How long does a project take?

The timeline depends on the scope and integrations. After discovery, we agree on milestones and a realistic schedule, then keep you involved with regular progress reviews.

Can you improve our existing software?

Yes. We can review an existing system, identify the highest-impact improvements, and plan a gradual upgrade or migration around your business needs.

Do you provide support after launch?

Support and maintenance can be included in your project agreement. We define the coverage, communication channels, and response expectations before launch.

How do you approach security?

We consider security throughout the product lifecycle, including access controls, input validation, dependency updates, testing, and the handling of sensitive data. Specific requirements are agreed during discovery.

Who owns the finished software?

Source code, intellectual property, hosting access, and handover terms are set out in the project agreement so ownership is clear before development begins.
